svg.text: Fig 2a - MMIO Interconnect (1/2): Address Decode and Write Enables
Pure combinational. addr[31]=1 selects the MMIO window; addr[11:3] picks a peripheral; each write enable = cs & d_we
slices of the core data-bus address / strobes
-> Data Memory byte-write enables (bit i = cs_dmem & d_we & d_wstrb[i])
cs_in cs_tmr cs_col cs_spr cs_maze cs_dmem
addr[6:2] and d_wdata go straight to peripherals
